This validates the composition below but is not the exact production entry/factory list and does not validate builtin OAuth, Codex headers, network transport or production response IDs.

root_input_schema.caps: RunControllerConfig uses synthetic_test_context=false and the full production FROZEN_PRODUCTION_CAPS. Non-frozen cleanup/observer fields must come from the root-reviewed process deployment; no reduced test cap is represented as production.

namespace.layout: Dedicated 0700 canonical directory outside repo/controller/artifact/session/profile. Four empty regular __init__.py files plus only the exact reviewed copied module members and root test driver.
namespace.seal: After all copies close, capture_tree with max128 members,1MiB/member,8MiB aggregate,relative path<=4096. Root matches each destination member to its independently opened source bytes and later verify_tree before every native import.

bootstrap_risk_assessment.recommended_entry: Open namespace O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, verify embedded canonical path/device/inode/mode0700, then fchdir the held fd before execve. Plain chdir(path) leaves an avoidable name re-resolution race.
bootstrap_risk_assessment.argv: Reject sys.argv length !=1. execve approved existing interpreter invocation with [-B,-m,module,--config,fixed absolute,--config-sha256,fixed hash]. No PYTHONPATH, sys.path edit, dynamic path or model input.
bootstrap_risk_assessment.environment: execve exact LANG=C.UTF-8, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin, TZ=UTC. No HOME/profile/provider/TMPDIR/PI/internal variables. PATH is not authority because bound bridge executables/config paths are absolute.
bootstrap_risk_assessment.cwd: The module import cwd is sealed namespace, not controller cwd. phase_gate uses absolute config paths and compares the separately supplied controller cwd to native session identity; searched sources contain no Path.cwd/os.getcwd dependency.
bootstrap_risk_assessment.git_gate: Controller cwd stays a private non-Git directory, so Prime cannot skip a failed native gate using unchanged Git state.
bootstrap_risk_assessment.failure_output: Bridge bootstrap failure emits only {"error":"INTERNAL_ERROR","ok":false}; gate bootstrap failure emits STOP_PROTOCOL_INVALID and exits0. Parent still requires a durable typed gate outcome; exit0/stdout never proves readiness.
residuals: Python site initialization occurs before bootstrap top-level and again on -B -m; -B is not isolated mode. Existing interpreter/venv/site packages remain TCB outside namespace member seal.
fchdir/execve and root pre-import revalidation are not fexecve/pidfd or hostile-same-UID proof.
Minimal exec environment intentionally drops controller TMP/profile; Bridge FixedNativePort may separately use its sealed synthetic config environment for fake ORX subprocesses.

steps.action: Root copies current exact modules/test_bridge plus driver into regular namespace, writes empty package inits, captures and independently verifies SourceTree. Create bridge/gate bootstraps outside namespace.

Instantiate reviewed test_bridge.NativeHarness(rows=292) from namespace. Write/hash deployment and load it with load_bridge_from_config so FixedNativePort, local fake ORX, local Git and 127.0.0.1 getter are real.

Seed two dev results through Bridge.handle: request first, observe RUNNING, NativeHarness.mark_done, read_dev_result; write second solution+intent with first parent_run_id, request/observe/mark_done, re-read. Require two distinct valid rows292 results, research.md nonempty, no third/final request.

Create initial phase_gate deployment with exact Bridge FileBinding, empty session identity, controller cwd, exact provider/model/budget120000, no prior session, final-lock path and empty root-private outcome directory. Write/hash fixed gate wrapper.

Use write_extension_binding and write_frontend_deployment for real production-shaped assets. Use write_process_config to produce/revalidate the non-executed production config for actual controller-main. Separately construct a hash-bound test-only RunControllerConfig for the Faux frontend with identical production env/caps; mark the outer combination receipt synthetic.

Create UsageObserver(UsageObserverConfig(session_dir,cwd,provider,model,120000,())). campaign_guard returns only observation.stop_reason; WAITING_FIRST_USAGE maps to None. Arm independent threading.Event at <=20s, call run_controller once, cancel timer after return. No retry on any uncertain/non-success result.

Reopen typed process receipt, session JSONL, contiguous gate outcomes, Bridge public/dev views and all manifests. Require pass predicates. Copy only allowlisted synthetic receipts; delete profile without opening/copying auth.json; close loopback server.
Write one immutable combination receipt with hashes, exact commands, counts, elapsed/resources/limitations. Stop; do not promote to P0 admission.

usage_observer_mapping.campaign_guard: Return None for WAITING_FIRST_USAGE/WITHIN_BUDGET; return only CAMPAIGN_TOKEN_TRIGGER or CAMPAIGN_USAGE_UNKNOWN; exceptions and other states become CAMPAIGN_USAGE_UNKNOWN through run_controller.
usage_observer_mapping.parallel_gate_observer: phase_gate creates its own config-bound observer/checkpoint history. Both read the same single native session. Final counts/hashes must agree; neither is current-response backpressure.
usage_observer_mapping.original_fixture_excluded: Do not reuse installed-main-native-session-v1.jsonl as positive evidence; it has zero response IDs and is USAGE_UNKNOWN with 3745 known tokens.

pass_predicates: A separately labeled test-only RunControllerConfig validates the production branch (synthetic_test_context=false), exact eight parent env and full production caps, and binds the test frontend; the normal write_process_config output binds actual controller-main and is validated but not executed. Supplemental abort_event did not fire; elapsed<20s.

ControllerRunReceipt status=succeeded, terminal_reason=completed, returncode=0, cleanup confirmed for all tracked processes, no resource/campaign trigger, stdout/stderr and total test artifact bytes <=1MiB as observed assertions (not substituted caps).
No daemon socket/service; test entry loaded real controller-main pre/post and explicit controller-extension source; provider and active tool schemas exactly the six unchanged tools.

Native session header id/cwd/provider/model match; exactly the intended assistant records have unique nonempty expected response IDs and all four usage categories; UsageObserver complete WITHIN_BUDGET and total<120000.

Gate history is contiguous/config-bound; latest durable outcome is READY_INITIAL_CHECKPOINT with exactly two distinct seeded verified dev run IDs, same complete usage observation and hashed research. STOP or missing outcome is failure even when gate/process exit0.
Real loaded Bridge returns exactly two valid rows292 dev results and remaining_dev_opportunities=1; model tool read_public_result caused no new attempt/binding/receipt/context/final-lock file.
Namespace SourceTree, bootstrap/config/frontend/process identities and every declared member byte reverify unchanged after run.
No auth contents, raw data, predictions, arbitrary bridge stdout/stderr or fake ORX internals enter frontend stdout/session/model context/evidence archive.
stop_conditions: any new Bridge launch or state mutation from model read
confounds_and_nonclaims: The Faux factory is an explicit test-only provider override. It does not test builtin openai-codex OAuth, headers, token refresh, paid transport, latency or real response ID behavior.

controller_deployment.write_process_config hard-binds actual controller-main.ts and cannot produce the Faux test frontend. Direct construction with synthetic_test_context=false exercises production enforcement but the native receipt has no synthetic marker; only the external combination receipt prevents misclassification.

The process executes a separate test frontend, not controller-main.ts direct entry. prepareControllerMain, public main, exact mainArgs, fixed extension and postflight are exercised; production private executeControllerMain/catch/direct-exit and exact one-factory list are not.

NativeHarness invokes a fake ORX executable, local Git and loopback status service. mark_done synthesizes prediction/receipt bytes. No actual ORX lifecycle, Docker, training or hidden score is tested.
Full production process caps are validated, but <=20s abort and <=1MiB observed outputs are supplemental test assertions. They do not replace phase/campaign/file/RSS caps or make RSS hard.
Usage and gate checks account only completed assistant records. There is still no hard current-response token cap/backpressure; monitored overshoot remains.
Regular namespace closure covers copied Python source only. Interpreter, stdlib, site packages, shared libraries, kernel, Git and OS remain external TCB.
Same-UID concurrent mutation remains excluded by A2 TCB. Hash chains/manifests are not signatures or hostile-host proof.

producer_integration.production_only: write_process_config always derives frontend_path from deployment assets.controller_main, which prepareControllerMain requires to be the actual controller-main.ts.

The root test driver must construct a distinctly test-only RunControllerConfig binding the test frontend while keeping exact production env/caps, validate it with _validate_config, and identify it as synthetic in an external combination receipt. It must also produce—but not execute—the normal production config with write_process_config.
